**Claim statement** (one falsifiable sentence)

<!-- e.g. "E2E tests need the compose Postgres; scripts/e2e.sh boots and tears it down" -->

**How would you verify it?**

```bash
# the check that would make this claim executable
```

**Kind** — fact / command / trap / policy / ownership

**Why it matters** — what does an agent (or human) get wrong today without this claim?

**Evidence** — where did this observation come from (session logs, incident, PR)?

> Remember: agents propose, humans accept. If this came from a session, it should
